text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Auuuuugh... I lost. But... but still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations~, Opera O-san! It seems 
victory belongs to us.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! This victory was only possible 
thanks to you! And Doto put up a good 
fight as well, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Opera O and Doto are doing pretty 
well. Think they've caught up to the 
Golden Generation by now?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I really don't think that's it. The 
race itself was a bit lukewarm, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, turned out cleanly according to the 
numbers, just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's like a wind tunnel test out there. 
Opera O up high, Doto right below her in a 
total deadlock...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two... ain't gonna reach the 
generation above 'em. Not the 'Strongest 
Generation' that's broken the game at the 
very top.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, Opera O-san! Did I pass with this...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... have I become a sparkling Umamusume 
worthy of being your partner? W-W-What do 
you think?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Doto! You are my irreplaceable 
right hand!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before surpassing the previous generation 
at the Arima Kinen, why don't we run in 
the Japan Cup next?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We shall show our peerless bond to the 
entire world! Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, Opera O-san! Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer, Opera O called me 
her "right-hand gal"~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could've pushed a little 
harder, but... it's okay... Opera O, whom 
I look up to so much, acknowledged me 
after all. Ehehe...
The answer was—already known.

The answer was—clear to see. It had been 
all along.

The true identity of the ceiling. It was— 
Meisho Doto's "salvation." The greatest 
reason she had managed to keep fighting 
this far.

Her "feelings" and "reservations" toward 
TM Opera O.

"...There's only one person I can consult. 
I decided to ask for Admire Vega's 
opinion."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Just as I expected... And this whole 
incident made it crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto doesn't, in the truest sense, have 
any real confidence.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because she's always judging everything by 
Opera O's standards. Being useful to Opera 
O, catching up to her, earning her 
recognition...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She has left even the judgment of whether 
she shines entirely in Opera O's hands...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And the negative impact of Doto not 
reaching her full potential is affecting 
Opera O as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O had now become one of the 
representative Umamusume of the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why rivals are 
necessary for growth. Normally, Doto 
should be the one doing that beside her. 
But..."

That might be true. Meisho Doto isn't the 
only one who has hit a plateau.

Even so, I have a feeling that one day, 
Meisho Doto will realize it herself and 
awaken.
choice_data_list:
If only it would awaken like it did that 
autumn...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No way. —Probably.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Think back to last autumn. What was it... 
that happened?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto didn't 'awaken on her own.' She 
simply 'had no choice but to awaken.'

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Because an accident happened. Because I 
had to withdraw. The reason why we had to 
change came from the outside...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"She... can't change on her own. Because 
she's too kind. She can't just suddenly 
turn the person she admires into an 
enemy."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You should know that. Both of us know it 
all too painfully well.

...It was just as they said. There's no 
way Meisho Doto would do something like 
that on her own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For her to become the person she wants to 
be... To truly awaken what's inside her...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The catalyst... has to be provided by 
someone. No matter how thankless of a role 
it might be.

—I have to talk to Meisho Doto. Without 
fail, before our next race, the Japan Cup.
